resources.string: Audit an APK or review verified security evidence
Choose an APK for an immediate on-device check, open evidence from your trusted Assay runner, or explore a sample to understand the review flow.
Pick an APK from your phone. Assay checks package flags, permissions, exported components, signing metadata, native code and other high-signal risks without uploading the file.
Import a snapshot produced by the Assay runner to review deterministic scanner findings, evidence state and remediation candidates.
See what a real findings and remediation review looks like before you configure a runner.
Useful immediately and fully offline. It is deterministic, but it is intentionally labelled as a quick check rather than full runner-verified evidence.
Adds Gitleaks, Semgrep, OSV, MobSF, tamper-evident publication and proof-bound remediation on the trusted runner.
